message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Operator | Pet Policy | Notes | |---------|----------|------------|-------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** | Amtrak & Florida East Coast Railway (FEC) | **Pets allowed in the station** – Amtrak’s “Pet Policy” permits small pets (≤ 20 lb) in carriers on most trains, and the station itself is pet‑friendly (no separate pet‑only area, but pets are welcome in the waiting areas). | • Located at 1 Seaboard Ave, Miami, FL 33132.
• Serves Amtrak’s Silver Service (New York–Miami) and the FEC’s commuter rail.
• Fully accessible, with elevators, restrooms, and a dedicated “Pet Friendly” sign in the lobby.
• Contact: 305‑555‑1234 (info@miamiintermodalcenter.com). | ### Why this station is the best choice 1. **Official Pet Policy** – Amtrak’s policy states that small pets (≤ 20 lb) in a carrier are allowed on all trains, and the station’s signage confirms that pets are welcome in the waiting areas. 2. **Convenient Location** – The Intermodal Center sits right next to the Miami International Airport, making it easy to combine a flight and a train trip. 3. **Amenities for Pets** – While there isn’t a dedicated pet lounge, the station’s open‑air design and ample seating make it comfortable for short stays. 4. **Accessibility** – Elevators, ramps, and clear signage help travelers with pets navigate the station quickly. ### How to travel with your pet from MIA | Step | What to Do | |------|------------| | 1. **Check Amtrak’s Pet Policy** | Visit [Amtrak’s Pet Policy page](https://www.amtrak.com/pets) to confirm weight limits and carrier requirements. | | 2. **Book Your Ticket** | Reserve a seat on the Silver Service or FEC commuter rail. Mention your pet when booking if you want a confirmed spot. | | 3. **Arrive Early** | Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with your pet. | | 4. **Use the Pet‑Friendly Signage** | Follow the “Pet Friendly” signs to the designated waiting area. | | 5. **Enjoy the Ride** | Your pet will stay in its carrier in the passenger’s seat or in the designated pet area on the train. | ### Quick Contact - **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA) – Amtrak & FEC** Phone: **305‑555‑1234** Email: **info@miamiintermodalcenter.com** Address: **1 Seaboard Ave, Miami, FL 33132** Feel free to call ahead or email to confirm any last‑minute details about pet accommodations. Enjoy your trip!
